description: Keep people and dates in DayHeart. add_person adds a person (name; birthday YYYY-MM-DD or MM-DD; note; a reminder 0, 1, 3 or 7 days before). add_date adds an important date (title, date, every year or once, the person it belongs to, a reminder 0, 1 or 7 days before). A person whose name is already there is not added a second time. update_person and update_date change them.

birthday.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or MM-DD when the year is unknown; empty string removes it

id.description: Person or date id, for update

note.description: Note about the person, up to 2000 characters

person_id.description: The person a date belongs to

remind_days_before.description: Remind this many days before; -1 removes the reminder

name: change_people
title: Change people and dates
